text_block_list.text:
Vodka is fired up with her Make Debut 
right before her eyes. But seeing her 
peers' laid-back attitude, she drops her 
shoulders in disappointment.

However, losing to a peer like that would 
make her look "uncool" as an Umamusume.

Determined not to have such a half-hearted 
debut, Vodka geared herself up and headed 
out to the race.
